display.purpose: Hero headlines and section titles (h1–h3). Georgia serif only.

body.purpose: Running text, paragraphs, descriptions. Trebuchet MS stack.

label.purpose: Eyebrow kickers above headings. Bold uppercase 10px, cinnabar or gold.

handwritten.purpose: Editorial asides, testimonials, supporting descriptions. Trebuchet MS italic.

shadows.name: scrapbook-shadow
shadows.value: broad diffuse shadow on image frames and cards
shadows.purpose: Physical depth on rotated image frames and featured cards.

shadows.name: btn-shadow
shadows.purpose: Primary and gold buttons at rest.

shadows.name: btn-shadow-hover
shadows.purpose: Primary button on hover (deepens + color-shifts to cinnabar).

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default easing for hover lifts, button transitions, and card reveals.

motion.name: duration-card
motion.purpose: Card hover lift and shadow expansion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Highest-priority action. Used for main CTAs — 'Plan My Trip', 'Book Now'. Straight corners, lifts on hover, kinetic shimmer.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #14343d; color: #fff; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.2em; padding: 1.25rem 2.5rem; border: none; border-radius: 0; font-family: 'Trebuchet MS', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 12px; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(20, 52, 61, 0.15); position: relative; overflow: hidden; z-index: 1; } .ds-btn-primary::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: linear-gradient(120deg, transparent 0%, rgba(255,255,255,0.4) 45%, transparent 70%); transform: translateX(-120%); transition: transform 680ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); z-index: -1; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #b64235; transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 12px 30px rgba(182, 66, 53, 0.25); } .ds-btn-primary:hover::before { transform: translateX(120%); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #b98a46; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Gold Button
components.description: CTA on dark surfaces (river-deep or night backgrounds). Gold at rest, shifts to river-deep on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-gold { background: #b98a46; color: #fff; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.2em; padding: 1.25rem 2.5rem; border: none; border-radius: 0; font-family: 'Trebuchet MS', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 12px; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(185, 138, 70, 0.15); } .ds-btn-gold:hover { background: #14343d; transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 12px 30px rgba(20, 52, 61, 0.2); } .ds-btn-gold:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #b98a46; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action alongside a primary. Transparent with river-deep border, fills on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { border: 1px solid #14343d; color: #14343d; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.2em; padding: 1.25rem 2.5rem; background: transparent; border-radius: 0; font-family: 'Trebuchet MS', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 12px; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: #14343d; color: #fff; box-shadow: 0 8px 25px rgba(20, 52, 61, 0.15); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #b98a46; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Paper Button
components.description: Soft secondary action. White bg with line border, lifts subtly on hover. Used alongside primary buttons.
components.css: .ds-btn-paper { border: 1px solid rgba(23, 32, 42, 0.13); background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.94); color: #14343d; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.2em; padding: 1.25rem 2.5rem; border-radius: 0; font-family: 'Trebuchet MS', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 12px; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); box-shadow: 0 10px 28px rgba(20, 52, 61, 0.08); } .ds-btn-paper:hover { border-color: #14343d; background: #fff; box-shadow: 0 14px 34px rgba(20, 52, 61, 0.12); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-paper:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #b98a46; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Ghost Dark Button
components.description: Button on dark surfaces (river-deep or night bg). Semi-transparent with backdrop blur, inverts on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost-dark { border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.72); background: rgba(17, 25, 35, 0.58); color: #fff; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.2em; padding: 1.25rem 2.5rem; border-radius: 0; font-family: 'Trebuchet MS', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 12px; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.3s ease; backdrop-filter: blur(12px); box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(17, 25, 35, 0.22); } .ds-btn-ghost-dark:hover { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.96); color: #111923; border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.96); } .ds-btn-ghost-dark:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #b98a46; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Tag / Chip
components.description: Informational label, non-interactive. Pill shape with line border on white/paper bg.
components.css: .ds-tag { display: inline-block; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid rgba(23, 32, 42, 0.13); background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7); color: #14343d; padding: 0.375rem 0.75rem; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.18em; font-family: 'Trebuchet MS', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Content container with scrapbook aesthetic. White/paper bg, line border, scrapbook-shadow. Lifts on hover.
components.html:
Card Title

Supporting description text.
components.css: .ds-card { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7); border: 1px solid rgba(23, 32, 42, 0.13); box-shadow: 0 22px 70px rgba(17, 25, 35, 0.12); border-radius: 0; transition: all 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-card:hover { transform: translateY(-2px) scale(1.01); box-shadow: 0 28px 90px rgba(17, 25, 35, 0.18); border-color: rgba(185, 138, 70, 0.5); } .ds-card-image { position: relative; aspect-ratio: 16 / 9; overflow: hidden; } .ds-card-image img { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; transition: transform 0.7s; } .ds-card:hover .ds-card-image img { transform: scale(1.05); } .ds-card-body { padding: 2rem; } .ds-card-title { font-family: Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif; font-size: 1.5rem; color: #14343d; transition: color 0.3s; } .ds-card:hover .ds-card-title { color: #b64235; } .ds-card-text { font-size: 0.875rem; color: #66717d; font-style: italic; line-height: 1.75; margin-top: 0.75rem; }

components.name: Eyebrow Label
components.description: Section kicker — small uppercase label above headings with a leading cinnabar line. Used sparingly.
components.css: .ds-eyebrow { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 1rem; margin-bottom: 2rem; } .ds-eyebrow-line { width: 2.5rem; height: 1px; background: #b64235; } .ds-eyebrow-label { font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.4em; color: #b64235; font-family: 'Trebuchet MS', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; }

components.name: Navigation Link
components.description: Top-level navigation item. River-deep on paper-deep bg. Hover transitions to cinnabar with a growing underline.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { color: #14343d; font-family: 'Trebuchet MS', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.2em; text-decoration: none; position: relative; transition: color 0.3s; } .ds-nav-link::after { content: ''; position: absolute; bottom: -4px; left: 0; width: 0; height: 1px; background: #b64235; transition: width 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: #b64235; } .ds-nav-link:hover::after { width: 100%; }

components.name: Scrapbook Image Frame
components.description: Signature pattern — an image wrapped in a white-bordered frame with shadow, slightly rotated, with ink-wash overlay.
components.css: .ds-scrapbook-frame { position: relative; aspect-ratio: 3 / 4; overflow: hidden; border: 1rem solid #fff; box-shadow: 0 22px 70px rgba(17, 25, 35, 0.12); transform: rotate(2deg); transition: transform 0.7s, box-shadow 0.7s; } .ds-scrapbook-frame img { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; transition: transform 1s; } .ds-scrapbook-frame:hover img { transform: scale(1.1); } .ds-scrapbook-inkwash { position: absolute; inset: 0; background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1); pointer-events: none; }

narrative.overview:
LingTour's visual system is an editorial archive in digital form — a field researcher's logbook where every page carries texture, evidence, and care. It is warm without sentimentality, authoritative without coldness, and richly textured without clutter. The system draws from printed matter: paper grain, ink washes, archival tape, scrapbook shadows, and the deliberate asymmetry of hand-assembled pages.

This is a brand-first system (the design IS the product for the public-facing site), with a secondary product register for the admin dashboard (Element Plus, serving the workflow). The system explicitly rejects cold corporate SaaS aesthetics, AI-generated landing-page templates, and the saturated 2026 default of cream/sand body backgrounds.
keyCharacteristics: Stone-paper neutrals with restrained warmth (never cream-by-default)
Deep teal-navy as the structural anchor; cinnabar and gold as ≤10% accent sparks
Serif display + humanist sans body: editorial authority meets approachable utility
Scrapbook materiality: white borders on images, rotated frames, ink-wash overlays
Tactile interaction: buttons lift, cards breathe, links shimmer
Purposeful motion: choreographed reveals that enhance an already-visible default

rules.name: The Spark Rule
rules.body: Cinnabar and gold are accent sparks, not structural colors. Combined, they must never exceed 10% of any given screen's visible surface. Their rarity is the point.

rules.name: The No-Warm-Default Rule
rules.body: The body background (paper-deep: #ece9e2) is chroma-neutral, not warm-tinted. 'Warmth in the brand' is carried by accent + typography + imagery, never by defaulting the body to cream/sand/parchment.

rules.name: The Ghost Border Rule
rules.body: Line borders at 1px and 13% opacity. Never use border-left > 1px as a colored accent stripe on cards or list items.

rules.name: The Single Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: One section-kicker (small uppercase label above a heading) is a deliberate brand voice; an eyebrow on every section is AI grammar. Use sparingly.

rules.name: The No-Similar-Pair Rule
rules.body: Georgia + Trebuchet works because serif display + humanist sans is a contrast axis. Never pair two serifs or two geometric sans-serifs.

rules.name: The Lift-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Interactive surfaces (buttons, cards, links) lift on hover with translateY(-2px) + shadow expansion. No element lifts without purpose.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: Non-interactive surfaces sit flat. Shadows appear only as a response to state (hover, focus, elevated containers).

dos: Use river-deep as the structural anchor — it carries headings, primary buttons, and dark-section backgrounds.
Keep cinnabar + gold combined ≤10% of any screen. They are accents, not a palette.
Use Georgia for all headings h1–h3. Never a sans-serif heading.
Use text-wrap: balance on h1–h3, text-wrap: pretty on body prose.
Use the scrapbook image frame pattern for hero and feature images.
Let interactive elements lift on hover — translateY(-2px) + shadow expansion is the tactile signature.
Respect prefers-reduced-motion — all animations must collapse to instant transitions.
donts: Don't use cream/sand/beige body backgrounds — paper-deep is chroma-neutral.
Don't use gradient text (background-clip: text) — prohibited.
Don't use glassmorphism as a default surface treatment.
Don't use the hero-metric template (big number, small label, gradient accent).
Don't use identical-card grids. Vary shapes, rotations, layouts — the scrapbook is hand-assembled.
Don't put an eyebrow label above every section heading.
Don't use border-left or border-right > 1px as a colored accent stripe.
Don't use cold corporate SaaS patterns on the brand site.
Don't animate CSS layout properties. Use transform and opacity only.
Don't use arbitrary z-index values like 999 or 9999.
